source: AlAdhan API v1 (api.aladhan.com/v1/timings), downloaded 2026, Meezaan/PrayerTimes engine (PrayTimes.org algorithm family). Asr school: Standard (Shafi) or Hanafi (school=1). High-latitude rule: ANGLE_BASED (API default). utc_offset = UTC offset at local noon of the record date (matches API's local time).
time_format: HH:MM 24h local wall clock at record location (rounded to minute with +30s)
note: ramadan flag = UmmAlQura records in Hijri month 9 (Ramaḍān); during Ramadan the reference uses Isha = Maghrib + 120 min instead of 90. Reference rounds each time by +30 s then truncates to the minute.
